meta.name: session-logs
meta.description: Search and analyze your own session logs (older/parent conversations) using jq.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 jq 搜索和分析历史会话日志
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从大量历史对话中快速查找和提取信息
copy.tagline_en: Search and analyze session logs with jq
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find and extract info from past conversations

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索和分析你之前的对话记录（会话日志）。它能帮你查找历史消息、统计对话成本、按日期或关键词筛选会话等。
howto.when: 当你询问之前的对话内容、历史上下文或提到旧会话时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下昨天和我的对话记录
say.note: Claude 会搜索指定日期的会话文件。

say.text: 搜索所有会话中包含“项目计划”的对话
say.note: Claude 会跨会话搜索关键词。

say.text: 统计最近一周的对话总花费
say.note: Claude 会计算各会话的成本并汇总。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search and analyze your previous conversation logs (session files). It can find historical messages, count conversation costs, filter sessions by date or keyword, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about previous chats, historical context, or older conversations.

say_en.note: Claude will search for sessions from that date.

say_en.text: Search all sessions for the phrase 'project plan'.
say_en.note: Claude will search across sessions for the keyword.

say_en.text: Show me the total cost for the last week.
say_en.note: Claude will calculate and sum costs per session.
